name: API and Integration Testing
purpose: Identify API and integration test scenarios only when the supplied requirements or project documentation describe APIs, services, external systems, integrations, requests, responses, or data exchange.

apply_when: The requirement explicitly describes an API.
The requirement describes an endpoint or service.
The requirement describes request or response behavior.
The requirement describes integration with another system.
The requirement describes data exchange between systems.
The requirement describes an external authentication provider.
The requirement describes an external dependency.
The requirement describes API validation or error behavior.
do_not_apply_when: No API or integration behavior is present.
An endpoint would have to be invented.
A request method would have to be invented.
A response structure would have to be invented.
An external system would have to be invented.
An HTTP status code would have to be invented.
An integration behavior is not supported by the supplied requirements.

coverage_dimensions.name: Valid Request
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined valid API requests.

coverage_dimensions.name: Required Request Data
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly required request fields or parameters.

coverage_dimensions.name: Missing Request Data
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when explicitly required request data is missing.

coverage_dimensions.name: Request Validation
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify request validation rules explicitly described by the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Response Validation
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined response data and behavior.

coverage_dimensions.name: Error Response
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined API error behavior.

coverage_dimensions.name: Authentication
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify API authentication when explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Authorization
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify API authorization when explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: External Integration
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify interactions with explicitly identified external systems.

coverage_dimensions.name: Dependency Failure
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify integration failure behavior when the requirement defines dependency failure handling.

coverage_dimensions.name: Timeout
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify API or integration timeout behavior only when timeout behavior is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Retry
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify retry behavior only when retry behavior is explicitly specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Data Consistency
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify data consistency across systems when explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Duplicate Request
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify duplicate-request handling only when idempotency or duplicate handling is explicitly relevant.

examples.requirement: The application sends the user's email and password to the authentication service and receives a successful login response.
applicable_scenarios: Valid credentials sent to authentication service

examples.requirement: If the payment provider rejects the transaction, the application displays the payment failure state.

unknown_information.rule: Missing API or integration details must be identified rather than invented.
